retrieval.rag_summary:
Metecno Board
represents insulated composite sandwich panels manufactured and supplied by
Metecno / Bondor Australia (such as MetecnoPanel and MetecnoSpan). Formed with
high-performance PIR, EPS-FR, or mineral wool cores bonded between Colorbond
steel skins, these structural panels provide integrated exterior cladding, vapor
barrier, and thermal insulation in a single element for commercial coolrooms,
distribution centers, and industrial facilities.
